```yaml
name: Update ESLint Plugin Changelog

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs at midnight every Monday
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Update changelog
        run: node tools/update-changelog.js 3.0.6

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "chore(eslint-plugin-sonarjs): update changelog"
          git push origin main

      - name: Create Pull Request
        id: cpr
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: SonarSource/SonarJS
          issue-number: 1168
          body: |
            ## Changelog Update

            The changelog has been updated automatically. Please review and merge this PR as soon as possible.

            <details>
              <summary>Changelog Diff</summary>

              ```diff
              diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
              index 1234567..89abcde 100644
              --- a/CHANGELOG.md
              +++ b/CHANGELOG.md
              @@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
               # Change Log

               +## [3.0.6](https://github.com/SonarSource/eslint-plugin-sonarjs/releases/tag/v3.0.6) (YYYY-MM-DD)
               +
               +- **Fix**: Updated `update-changelog.js` to use Jira API v3.
               +- **Add**: Added `fields=key,summary` parameter to the Jira API call.
               ```

              </details>
```

This workflow will run weekly on Mondays and can also be triggered manually. It updates the changelog using the `update-changelog.js` script, commits the changes, and creates a pull request to merge them into the main branch.
